row: A. AI is a sixth surge, now in installation (irruption or frenzy)

table_section: Three readings of the AI boom
row: A. AI is a sixth surge, now in installation (irruption or frenzy)
value: The key input is still microelectronics, the infrastructure rides on the internet and cloud, incumbents lead rather than new entrants, and a frenzy four years after a big bang would be historically early

row: B. AI is a late chapter of the fifth (ICT) surge
value: Perez's own position (2024–2025); AI depends on the internet and on ever-cheaper chips; its principles (information intensity, data as raw material, platforms) are ICT's; its leaders are ICT incumbents funding capex largely from cash flow

table_section: Three readings of the AI boom
row: B. AI is a late chapter of the fifth (ICT) surge
value: Makes the scale and speed of today's finance hard to explain as a 'last gasp'; ICT's turning point would have lasted more than 20 years, beyond any precedent
